asset.description:
This identifies the {@link ReliabilityAsset} for
which the sensor associations are computed.

sensorAssociations.description:
For the given {@link asset}, this represents a map of {@link Feature}s
to the associations computed for every {@link Sensor} evaluated
by the {@link ReliabilityAssetSensorAssociationJob}. The nested map
object has a value in the format of `[lag, absoluteAssociationValue, associationValueWithMagnitude, isCandidateSensor]`

title:
The return type of the {@link ReliabilityAssetSensorAssociationJob#map}
function.
name: ReliabilityAssetSensorAssociationResult
